caption: The drawing features a dress with a wide, full skirt and a fitted bodice, displayed on a headless and armless outline of a human figure. The dress is colored in a blue-and-white plaid pattern, with the lines of the plaid running horizontally and vertically throughout the garment. The bodice is off-the-shoulder with short sleeves and features decorative lace or trim at the edge of the sleeves and at the central front waist. The skirt has distinct horizontal bands that are more pronounced due to the arrangement of the plaid pattern, and the fullness of the skirt suggests a structured undergarment such as a crinoline. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller line drawing of the same dress, showing a simplified back or side view without coloring but indicating the structured bands and overall shape. The background is a light beige color.
title: Dress
